deliverables.summary: Version-6 discovery follows bounded local import chains and emits source-evidenced UI-to-API, UI-to-service, API-to-service, service-to-service, and data relationships.
Neo4j relationship projection recognizes the new UI/service and service/service relationship types.
Architecture projection omits project roots, retains only entity-to-entity relationships, and seeds rootless project-scoped force layouts without overlaps.
Architecture Canvas edges are solid, unlabeled, and non-directional; Insight shows relationship direction, type, entity kind, and source evidence.
Regression fixture proves imported page clients and repository services form a complete source-backed dependency chain.
Regression coverage proves project roots are absent, feature relationships remain connected, Canvas relations have no labels/arrows, and layouts do not overlap.
